Name: Isa's Yandere Sebastian Dialogue Expansion
Author: Isalamiii
Description:
[center][size=1]Hello everyone! If you have a thing for yanderes like me, this should be a treat for you! Enjoy! 
[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7697?tab=description]
NEW: A female bachelor variant of this mod for Genderbent Sebastian (Sabrina) has been released by Vilebeggar. Click here!
[/url]﻿﻿
[color=red][size=1][size=5][b]WARNINGS[/b][/size][/size][/color]
* [u]This mod is intended to be fictional and was created for personal interest and use. I do not condone murder or overly possessive behavior. If you are sensitive to such topics, as this mod includes mentions of killing, (two MENTIONS of animal killing) stalking, and obsessive behavior, I ask that you would not download it for your own safety.[/u]

[size=1][size=4]WHAT THIS MOD DOES[/size][/size]

[size=1]* Turns Sebastian into a yandere who is obsessed with you! This mod adds to and overhauls Sebastian's dialogue.
[size=4]
[color=#ea9999]FULL LIST OF FEATURES[/color][b]:[/b][/size]
- over 200 lines of both [color=#ff7700]pre-marriage[/color] and[color=#ff7700] post marriage dialogue[/color], and[color=#ff7700] festival dialogue[/color].
- [color=#f4f4f4]unique [/color][color=#ff7700]lines for when you've[/color] [color=#ff7700]divorce or are rejected by[/color] Sebastian, as well as [color=#ff7700]comments towards your current spouse[/color] if you're already married.
- Robin, along with bachelors and bachelorettes around Sebastian's age group will [color=#ff7700]comment on his behavior[/color] during the different seasons.
- unique lines for[color=#ff7700] receiving a bouquet[/color] or a[color=#ff7700] mermaid's pendant[/color].


[/size]
[size=1][size=4]HOW TO INSTALL[/size][/size]

[color=#ff0000][size=2]STEP 1[/size][/color][size=1][color=#ff0000]: [/color] * Install both SMAPI and Content Patcher[/size]
[size=1]* Extract/Open this file with either Winrar or 7zip.[/size]
[size=1]* Copy the folder named "[CP] Yandere Sebastian Dialogue Expansion" and paste it into your Mods folder, NOT the Content Patcher folder.[/size][size=1]
[/size][color=#ff0000]STEP 2[/color] (optional): [size=1]* Install MissCoriel's NPC Unique Courtship response
*[/size] [size=1]Open "config.json" and change Sebastian's setting from "enabled" to "disabled" to see the unique pendant/bouquet dialogues
* and now you're done! Your Seb is now crazy for you![/size]
[size=3]
USE[/size]
[size=1]* You are definitely allowed to use this mod in screenshots, videos, gameplay, etc![/size]
[size=1]* You are definitely allowed to combine this mod with whatever you want and edit it however you wish for your own use![/size]
[size=1]* However, please ask my permission before reuploading its download here, or somewhere else! Thank you![/size][/center]
